about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Menchi Katsu Japanese Crumbed Beef and Pork Patties
recipes.summary: Juicy crumbed mince patties fried until crisp, served with rice, shredded cabbage and tonkatsu-style sauce.
steps: Mix the beef, pork, onion, egg, breadcrumbs, soy sauce and 1/2 tsp salt, then shape into 8 oval patties.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Dust the patties in flour, dip in a thin paste of 1/2 cup flour and 1/2 cup water, then coat in panko.
Shallow-fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Mix the tomato sauce and Worcestershire sauce for the dipping sauce and serve with the cabbage and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the mince patties until they reach 75°C in the centre. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tatsuta-Age Japanese Soy Ginger Fried Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken thigh marinated in soy, ginger and sake, coated in potato starch and fried until crisp, with rice.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, sake, ginger and garlic.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Coat the chicken in cornflour and shallow-fry in batches for 6 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.
Serve with the rice and lemon wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chashu Pork Rice Bowls with Soft Egg
recipes.summary: Pork belly rolled-style braised in soy, mirin and ginger, sliced over rice with a soft-boiled egg.
steps: Brown the pork belly in a dry pot for 8 minutes on all sides.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger and 1 cup water, cover, and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender, turning twice.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and marinate in a little braising liquid.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Slice the pork, serve over the rice with an egg each, spoon over the liquid and scatter the spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender; boil the eggs for at least 6 minutes. Contains egg. Not suitable for anyone avoiding runny yolks. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

recipes.title: Tempura Prawn and Vegetable Plate with Rice
recipes.summary: Light, crisp prawns and vegetables in ice-cold batter, served with rice and a soy dipping sauce.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin and 2 tbsp water for dipping.
Stir the flour, cornflour and iced water together lightly, leaving lumps.
Heat the oil to 180°C, dip the prawns and vegetables and fry in batches for 3 minutes until pale golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and serve straight away with the rice and dipping sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Samgyeopsal Korean Grilled Pork Belly Lettuce Wraps
recipes.summary: Crisp-edged pork belly slices wrapped in lettuce with rice, garlic and a sesame ssamjang-style dip.
steps: Mix the miso, gochujang, sesame oil, spring onion and sesame seeds for the dip.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Grill or pan-fry the pork belly for 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Fry the garlic in the pork fat for 2 minutes until golden.
Wrap pork, rice, garlic and dip in lettuce leaves and eat in one bite.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dakgangjeong Korean Sticky Crispy Chicken Bites
recipes.summary: Crisp fried chicken pieces tossed in a sweet, garlicky soy and gochujang glaze, served with rice.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Coat the chicken in cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Shallow-fry in batches for 7 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Simmer the soy sauce, honey, gochujang and garlic for 4 minutes until syrupy, then toss the chicken through.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gua Bao Taiwanese Braised Pork Belly Buns with Peanut
recipes.summary: Folded steamed buns with soy-braised pork belly, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.
steps: Simmer the pork belly in the soy sauce, sugar, star anise, ginger and 2 cups water, covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and salt.
Slice the pork thickly and reduce the braising liquid for 5 minutes until glossy.
Steam the buns for 5 minutes until soft and hot.
Fill each bun with pork, cucumber, coriander and peanuts, and spoon over a little liquid.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Taiwanese Popcorn Chicken Rice Plate with Basil
recipes.summary: Crunchy five-spice chicken bites fried with basil, served over rice with pickled cucumber.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in small chunks

steps: Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, five spice, pepper and garlic.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Coat the chicken in the starch, shake off the excess and fry in batches for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Fry the basil in the hot oil for 15 seconds until crisp.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and serve with the chicken, basil and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lo Mai Gai Cantonese Sticky Rice with Chicken and Mushroom
recipes.summary: Glutinous rice steamed with chicken, shiitake, oyster sauce and a hint of sesame, in foil parcels.

items: 6 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and sliced

steps: Soak the rice in water for 2 hours if possible, then drain.
Marinate the chicken with the oyster sauce, soy sauce, ginger and sesame oil.
Mix the chicken, mushrooms and rice, season with salt, and divide among 4 foil parcels.
Steam for 40 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Open the parcels and scatter with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Da Pan Ji Xinjiang Big Plate Chicken with Hand-Pulled-Style Noodles
recipes.summary: Chicken and potato braised in a star anise and chilli sauce, poured over wide noodles.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the onion, garlic, ginger, star anise and chilli flakes.
Add the soy sauce, potatoes and 2 cups water and simmer covered for 25 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the capsicum for 5 minutes.
Boil the noodles for 5 minutes until tender, drain and top with the chicken.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Gong Bao Ji Ding Sichuan Kung Pao Chicken with Peanuts
recipes.summary: Quick-fried chicken with dried chilli, Sichuan pepper and roasted peanuts in a sweet-sour glaze, with rice.
steps: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornflour.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp water for the sauce.
Stir-fry the chillies and Sichuan pepper in the oil for 30 seconds, add the chicken and fry for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the garlic, spring onions, peanuts and sauce, and toss for 2 minutes until glossy. Serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hakka Salt-Baked Style Chicken with Ginger Spring Onion Oil
recipes.summary: Roasted whole chicken pieces rubbed with salt and five spice, served with rice and ginger oil.
steps: Rub the chicken with the five spice and 2 tsp salt, and roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until the skin is golden and crisp.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil until shimmering and pour over the ginger, spring onion and soy sauce for the oil.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then serve with the oil and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Pla Rad Prik Thai Crispy Fish with Sweet Chilli Sauce
recipes.summary: Crisp-fried fish fillets topped with a sweet, sour and garlicky chilli sauce, served with rice.
steps: Dust the fish in cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Fry the fish for 4 minutes each side until golden and crisp, then drain.
Fry the garlic and chillies in a little oil for 1 minute, add the sweet chilli sauce, fish sauce, vinegar, sugar and 1/4 cup water and simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Pour over the fish and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tod Mun Pla Thai Fish Cakes with Cucumber Dip
recipes.summary: Springy fish cakes with red curry paste and green beans, fried until golden, served with rice and a sweet cucumber dip.
steps: Blend the fish with the curry paste, egg and fish sauce into a sticky paste, then fold through the beans.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Stir the cucumber, vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for the dip.
Shape into 12 patties and fry for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve the fish cakes with rice and dip.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish cakes until they reach 63°C in the centre and the egg is set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hor Mok Thai Steamed Fish Curry Custard
recipes.summary: A soft, mousse-like steamed fish and coconut curry custard served with jasmine rice.
steps: Blend the fish with the curry paste, eggs, half the coconut milk and fish sauce until smooth.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Divide the spinach among four heatproof bowls, then pour in the fish mixture.
Steam for 20 minutes until just set, then spoon over the remaining warm coconut milk.
Serve with the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the custard until set and the fish reaches 63°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sai Ua Northern Thai Herb Pork Sausage Patties
recipes.summary: Spiced pork patties with lemongrass, galangal-style ginger and curry paste, grilled and served with sticky rice.
steps: Mix the pork, curry paste, lemongrass, ginger, lime leaves and fish sauce until sticky.
Steam the rice until tender, about 25 minutes.
Shape into 8 patties and fry in the oil for 5 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Serve with the sticky rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork patties until they reach 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bun Thit Nuong Vietnamese Grilled Pork with Vermicelli
recipes.summary: Lemongrass pork slices over rice noodles with herbs, cucumber and nuoc cham dressing.
steps: Marinate the pork with the lemongrass, garlic, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 2 teaspoons sugar.
Soak or boil the noodles until tender, rinse and drain.
Grill the pork over high heat for 4 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Stir the lime juice, remaining fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water for the dressing.
Serve the pork over noodles with the vegetables, herbs and dressing.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Cha Gio Vietnamese Pork and Prawn Spring Rolls
recipes.summary: Crisp rolls of pork, prawn, mushroom and glass noodle fried until golden, served with lettuce and herbs.

items: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and chopped

steps: Soak the noodles until soft and chop.
Mix the pork, prawns, noodles, mushrooms, carrot, fish sauce and pepper.
Roll a tablespoon of filling in each wrapper, folding in the sides and sealing with water.
Fry in the oil in batches for 6 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.
Wrap in lettuce with mint to eat.
notes: Food safety: cook the rolls until the filling reaches 75°C and the prawns are opaque and pink (63°C). Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Rawon East Javanese Black Beef Stew with Rice
recipes.summary: Beef slow-cooked in a dark, earthy spice paste with lemongrass and lime leaves, served with rice.
steps: Blend the onion, garlic, ginger and spices with 1/2 cup water into a paste and fry in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the beef, lemongrass, lime leaves and 3 cups water and simmer covered for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in the tamarind and 1 tsp salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sambal Goreng Udang Indonesian Prawns in Chilli Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Prawns in a spicy chilli and tomato sauce with coconut milk, served with rice.
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and tamarind and cook for 5 minutes until pulpy.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Pour in the coconut milk and 1/2 tsp salt, add the prawns and simmer for 4 minutes until pink and firm.
Serve over the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Murtabak Malaysian Stuffed Pan-Fried Flatbread with Spiced Lamb
recipes.summary: Thin flatbread folded around spiced lamb, onion and egg, fried until crisp.
steps: Fry the lamb, one onion, curry powder and ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 10 minutes until the lamb is cooked through and dry.
Beat the eggs, stir in the lamb, second onion and 1/2 tsp salt.
Place a quarter of the mixture in the centre of each flatbread and fold in the sides to make a square parcel.
Fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and the egg is set.
Cut in squares and serve with sliced cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C and the egg until fully set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Roti John Malaysian Egg and Minced Beef Sandwich
recipes.summary: Bread fried with a savoury beef and egg topping, a Malaysian street favourite, served with chilli sauce.
steps: Fry the beef and onion in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through and browned.
Whisk the eggs with the beef mixture and a pinch of salt.
Cook the roll halves cut-side down in a pan, pouring a quarter of the egg mixture on each, for 4 minutes until the egg is set and the bread crisp.
Drizzle with the chilli and tomato sauces and serve in squares.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and the egg until set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Sambal Stingray-Style Grilled Fish in Banana Leaf
recipes.summary: White fish fillets topped with a fiery sambal and grilled in foil parcels, served with rice.
steps: Blend the chillies, shallots, garlic, shrimp paste, tamarind, sugar and oil into a sambal.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Spread the sambal over the fish, wrap in foil and grill or bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Serve with the rice and lime wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Menudo Filipino Pork and Vegetable Tomato Stew
recipes.summary: Pork cubes simmered with potatoes, carrots and capsicum in a tomato sauce, served with rice.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the pork and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce and 1 cup water and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer for 15 minutes until the pork and vegetables are tender, adding the capsicum for the last 5.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
